steps.narration: Consumer surplus is what you planned to pay minus what you actually paid.
Subtract eighty kobo from one hundred and twenty kobo to get forty kobo.
Divide forty kobo by one hundred to convert to naira, giving zero point four zero naira.
Find the percentage change in quantity from the initial one thousand kilograms, which is fifty percent.
Find the percentage change in price from the initial ten kobo, which is minus fifty percent.
Price elasticity of demand is the percentage change in quantity over the percentage change in price.
Fifty percent divided by minus fifty percent has an absolute value of one point zero zero.

steps.display: Growth rate = Birth rate − Death rate
steps.narration: Population growth rate equals birth rate minus death rate.
Put in twelve percent for the growth rate and fifty-two percent for the death rate.
Add fifty-two percent to twelve percent to get a birth rate of sixty-four percent.
